title: whisper.cpp / OpenAI-compatible (transcription)
description: A speech-to-text model on any server that speaks OpenAI's transcription API (whisper.cpp, faster-whisper / Speaches, vLLM), on this machine or your network, as gohort's ears: the upload and the reply are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Start the server with a speech model. whisper.cpp: whisper-server -m <model> --port 8089 --inference-path /v1/audio/transcriptions (its default path is /inference, which this connector does not call). Speaches and vLLM serve /v1/audio/transcriptions as they are. The connector takes no key and lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors, run Test on its row (it sends one second of a tone, which has no words, so an empty answer passes), then pick it under Capabilities > Audio Transcription. A server that takes a key: add a bearer credential for its address under API Credentials and name it in the spec's auth in place of none.

questions.name: base_url
questions.label: Server address
questions.help: The address its /audio/transcriptions is under, usually ending in /v1: http://localhost:8089/v1 for whisper.cpp, http://localhost:8000/v1 for Speaches or vLLM.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the transcription settings list it by this name.

questions.name: model
questions.label: Model
questions.help: The name the server loaded the model as (Speaches and vLLM check it, e.g. Systran/faster-whisper-small; whisper.cpp takes any).
